title: The nilpotent Koszul tensor tower is graded split proconstant
statement: For any scheme X, commutative ring B, finite list b:Fin r→B, positive a with b_j^a=0, and complex C, let T be the tower of complexes koszulTensor X B r b C with its specified transitions (def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-koszul-completion). For every cochain degree p there is a natural transformation β_p from the evaluated tower T^p to the constant object C^p, such that the tensor-unit component followed by β_p is identity and every a-step transition T_(n+a)^p→T_n^p equals β_(n+a),p followed by the tensor-unit component at n. These are graded retractions and need not be chain maps.

source.place: Proof, order 1328, sentences three through five

proof.text: Project the total tensor onto its summand with exterior degree zero. The coefficient unit identifies this summand with C^p. Exterior degree zero is the coefficient ring and its transition is identity; this gives the splitting and naturality.

source.place: Proof, order 1328, sentences three through five

proof.text: On the generator module the diagonal map e_j↦b_j e_j has a-th power zero, by evaluation on Finsupp.single. Functoriality of exterior powers shows that the composite of a transitions vanishes in each positive exterior degree, while the zeroth exterior power is identity. Reindex to the cochain complex, apply constant sheafification and tensor with C. The coproduct inclusions characterize total-degree maps, giving exactly the asserted factorization.

lean.statement:
theorem nilpotentKoszulGradedTower (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B]
    (r : ℕ) (b : Fin r → B) (a : ℕ) (_ha : 0 < a) (hb : ∀ j, b j ^ a = 0)
    (C : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X B)) ℤ) :
    let T := Functor.ofOpSequence (koszulTensorTransition X B r b C)
    ∃ β : ∀ p : ℤ,
        (T ⋙ HomologicalComplex.eval _ (.up ℤ) p) ⟶
          (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj (C.X p),
      (∀ n p, (koszulTensorUnit X B r b C n).f p ≫ (β p).app (op n) = 𝟙 (C.X p)) ∧
      (∀ n p, (T.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n a)).op).f p =
        (β p).app (op (n + a)) ≫ (koszulTensorUnit X B r b C n).f p)
